summary: Server configuration is a one-time step per distribution server (create a namespace, get and set an API token), while building, preparing and publishing repeat for every release.
questions: Do I need to configure Galaxy credentials every time I publish?
What one-time setup is required before publishing collections?

answer_card.title: One-time distribution server setup
answer_card.answer_md:
Configure each server once:
1. Create a namespace.
2. Get an API token.
3. Specify the token.

Building, preparing and publishing must be repeated for every new collection or version.
